items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Benny Payton liked me and I was replacing this very great Al Morgan... I asked Benny Payton... Benny called the changes and I was blowing

ctx.x: Okay. So then when you went with the band, what did you do?

Well it was great for me because Kay Johnson had recommended me and I was about the youngest guy in the band. Benny Payton liked me and I was replacing this very great Al Morgan, who was photogenic and he was just magnificent on the stage.
